acceptance: `--phases generate,load` completes with exit 0 and records data_loading in the result
Regression test covers a load-only run without a power phase
context: Found 2026-10-15 during a local DuckDB check for PR #3013; reproduced on unmodified develop. The Snowflake trial campaign used the fallback `generate,load,power --iterations 1` instead.
description: On develop (2026-10-15), `benchbox run --platform duckdb --benchmark tpch --scale 0.01 --seed 42 --phases generate,load --non-interactive` loads the data ("Data loading completed") and then fails with "Benchmark execution failed: 'NoneType' object has no attribute 'overall_status'" and "Data loading failed: FAILED", exiting 1. The same command with `generate,load,power` succeeds. Load-only runs, which campaign plans use to prepare databases, cannot complete.
